Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

zisar 0.1.0

First release.

  • zisar() fits the ZISAR model from a two-part formula y ~ count terms | zero-inflation terms and a spatial weights matrix (base matrix, sparse Matrix or spdep listw); zisar_fit() is the matrix interface.
  • Estimation by Laplace approximation in ‘TMB’, with the log-determinant from the eigenvalues of W or, for large n, from a sparse Cholesky factor.
  • fixed holds parameters at given values, for the nested ZINB-RE (rho = 0) and SAR-NB-RE models.
  • zero_spatial = TRUE fits the general model, with a SAR random field in the zero-inflation predictor (parameters rho0 and sigma0); rzisar() simulates from it with sigma0 > 0.
  • offset() terms in the count part, for exposures.
  • Methods: summary(), coef(), vcov(), logLik() (hence AIC(), BIC()), nobs(), fitted(), residuals(), predict() (including counterfactual scenarios on the same units) and simulate().
  • zisar_effects(): average direct, indirect and total effects with simulation standard errors, including the zero-inflation channel.
  • rzisar() simulates from the model; lattice_weights() builds lattice contiguity weights.

Developed by Niccolò Salvini, Giuseppe Arbia, Vincenzo Nardelli.
